transcript: Most slide headlines are labels, like Overview or Pricing. They tell you what a slide is about, but not what it's saying. Let's change that.
A label like Q3 results leaves people guessing. Q3 revenue beat target by a comfortable margin gives the chart a job: proving it.
Ask so what: what should the audience conclude? Then say it in one short, specific sentence. Onboarding now takes two days instead of five beats onboarding time.
Now read your headlines in order, as a list. In a rewritten sales deck, the new headlines alone make a complete pitch.
In a narrated video, your notes become the voiceover. Open by restating the headline aloud, so the point lands twice: on screen and in their ears.
On Pro, a.i. directs your video, landing each headline as it's spoken. Ordinary slides in, extraordinary video out. Try Basic first, no subscription needed, at powerpoint2vid.com.
